title: 4.6 Regression: Crash on saving w/ custom classes
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6-stable, 4.6.1
Not in 4.5.1-stable, not in c5e6fde0c7e25608e8866abde2a72dc903048bf2

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Devuan GNU/Linux 6 (excalibur) 6 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 SUPER (nvidia) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.55 GiB memory

### Issue description

@Dj1nus discovered that PR #109458 `Add indicator to linked resources` introduced code that causes a crash in Terrain3D, and presumably any class that implements _get_property_list() and _get() in the way we have.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/pull/1904 Did help improve this and fix my crashing on windows. However DJ is still crashing on linux.

These crashes begin in our _get_property_list() or _get(), but end often in the STL or cowdata. Here are several call stacks, which are all very different [Callstacks.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25690848/Callstacks.txt), though the code and process is the same.

Here's our [_get_property_list()](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/blob/main/src/terrain_3d_material.cpp#L1061), and our [_get()](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/blob/main/src/terrain_3d_material.cpp#L1213).


### Steps to reproduce

* Create a new project with 4.6+
* Download this build https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/actions/runs/22576817642
* Unzip it in your project folder
* Open the demo
* Select the Terrain3D node, and repeatedly save. No need to change anything. It might take up to 60 saves.

This build uses the godot-cpp 4.5 branch, dcfab8de26e62c17b0f06c796125a63b1e437569, and includes the godot-cpp fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot-cpp/pull/1904.

I can't reproduce it on windows anymore. I used to be able to before the godot-cpp fix, as shown below. DJ can still produce it on demand in Linux, after the offending commit 804188d320a1d6405d8f42c6277b511b51bd005e, but not in the previous c5e6fde0c7e25608e8866abde2a72dc903048bf2. 

There are more details on our downstream issue https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/issues/945.


----
### Archived

Both of us have independently confirmed that the crash occurs after that PR in 804188d320a1d6405d8f42c6277b511b51bd005e, and not in the previous commit c5e6fde0c7e25608e8866abde2a72dc903048bf2. It occurs on windows or linux.

The error messages, crashes and call stacks are very different each time. Often but not always crashing in the STL, or cowdata or memory.cpp. For instance here are callstacks from four crashes [errors.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25639846/errors.txt), and here's from [another](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/issues/945#issuecomment-3979577352).

There are more details on our downstream issue https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/issues/945.

Here is our implementation of 
[_get_property_list() v1.0.1](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/blob/1.0/src/terrain_3d_material.cpp#L831) for the version in the MRP below.

However if we need to redesign our function for the new version of Godot, it will be based on this implementation of [_get_property_list() v1.1-dev](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/blob/main/src/terrain_3d_material.cpp#L1061). Here is a [build ](https://github.com/TokisanGames/Terrain3D/actions/runs/22325573689) of our `main` branch that matches this code.



### Steps to reproduce

* Create a new project
* Download Terrain3D from the asset library
* Open the demo
* Select the Terrain3D node
* Save repeatedly. It should crash in 1-50 saves in 4.6, but not 4.5.
